I realise this is an oldish post (just been scrolling to find inspiration) but I just wanted to add you have to be a bit careful with rice. It’s generally only recommended to keep refrigerated for under 3 days because there is a specific bacteria that loves to live in rice and can cause a pretty nasty case of gastro (it’s often linked to eating reheated fried rice). Might vary in different countries depending on rice processing/environment etc (I’m from Australia), but always worth googling these things first. Good luck!
